verses.en: By those [winds] that scatter far and wide,
verses.ar: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا

verses.en: and those that are heavily laden,
verses.ar: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا

verses.en: that speed freely,
verses.ar: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا

verses.en: that distribute [rain] as ordained!
verses.ar: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا

verses.en: What you [people] are promised is true:
verses.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ

verses.en: the Judgement will come––
verses.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

verses.en: by the sky with its pathways,
verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ

verses.en: you differ in what you say––
verses.ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ

verses.en: those who turn away from it are [truly] deceived.
verses.ar: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ

verses.en: Perish the liars,
verses.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ

verses.en: those steeped in error and unaware!
verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ

verses.en: They ask, ‘When is this Judgement Day coming?’
verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

verses.en: On a Day when they will be punished by the Fire,
verses.ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ

verses.en: ‘Taste the punishment! This is what you wished to hasten.’
verses.ar: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

verses.en: The righteous will be in Gardens with [flowing] springs.
verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

verses.en: They will receive their Lord’s gifts because of the good they did before:
verses.ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ

verses.en: sleeping only little at night,
verses.ar: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

verses.en: praying at dawn for God’s forgiveness,
verses.ar: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ

verses.en: giving a rightful share of their wealth to the beggar and the deprived.
verses.ar: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

verses.en: On earth there are signs for those with sure faith––
verses.ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ

verses.en: and in yourselves too, do you not see?––
verses.ar: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

verses.en: in the sky is your sustenance and all that you are promised.
verses.ar: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

verses.en: By the Lord of the heavens and earth! All this is as real as your speaking.
verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ

verses.en: [Muhammad], have you heard the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?
verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

verses.en: They went in to see him and said, ‘Peace.’ ‘Peace,’ he said, [adding to himself] ‘These people are strangers.’
verses.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

verses.en: He turned quickly to his household, brought out a fat calf,
verses.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ

verses.en: and placed it before them. ‘Will you not eat?’ he said,
verses.ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

verses.en: beginning to be afraid of them, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid.’ They gave him good news of a son who would be gifted with knowledge.
verses.ar: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ

verses.en: His wife then entered with a loud cry, struck her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman?’
verses.ar: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ

verses.en: but they said, ‘It will be so. This is what your Lord said, and He is the Wise, the All Knowing.’
verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

verses.en: Abraham said, ‘What is your errand, messengers?’
verses.ar: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

verses.en: They said, ‘We are sent to a people lost in sin,
verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

verses.en: to bring down rocks of clay,
verses.ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ

verses.en: marked by your Lord for those who exceed all bounds.’
verses.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ

verses.en: We brought out such believers as were there-
verses.ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: We found only one household devoted to God-
verses.ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

verses.en: and left the town to be a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

verses.en: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
verses.ar: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

verses.en: Pharaoh turned away with his supporters, saying, ‘This is a sorcerer, or maybe a madman,’
verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

verses.en: so We seized him and his forces and threw them into the sea: he was to blame.
verses.ar: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ

verses.en: There is another sign in the Ad: We sent the life-destroying wind against them
verses.ar: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ

verses.en: and it reduced everything it came up against to shreds.
verses.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

verses.en: And also in the Thamud: it was said to them, ‘Make the most of your lives for a while,’
verses.ar: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

verses.en: but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them. They looked on helplessly:
verses.ar: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

verses.en: they could not even remain standing, let alone defend themselves.
verses.ar: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ

verses.en: Before that We destroyed the people of Noah. They were a truly sinful people!
verses.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

verses.en: We built the heavens with Our power and made them vast,
verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

verses.en: We spread out the earth- how well We smoothed it out!-
verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ

verses.en: and We created pairs of all things so that you [people] might take note.
verses.ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.en: [So, say to them, Prophet], ‘Quickly, turn to God- I am sent by Him to give you clear warning-
verses.ar: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

verses.en: and do not set up any other god alongside Him. I am sent by Him to give you clear warning!’
verses.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

verses.en: Every previous people to whom a messenger was sent also said, ‘A sor-cerer, or maybe a madman!’
verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

verses.en: Did they tell one another to do this? No! They are a people who exceed all bounds,
verses.ar: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

verses.en: so ignore them [Prophet]- you are not to blame-
verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ

verses.en: and go on reminding [people], it is good for those who believe to be reminded.
verses.ar: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: I created jinn and mankind only to worship Me:
verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

verses.en: I want no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me-
verses.ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

verses.en: God is the Provider, the Lord of Power, the Ever Mighty.
verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ

verses.en: The evildoers, like their predecessors, will have a share of punishment- they need not ask Me to hasten it-
verses.ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

verses.en: and woe betide those who deny the truth on the Day they have been promised.
verses.ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
